rejections.name: su2-compactness-heine-borel
rejections.wall: SU(2) compactness + Haar via Heine-Borel / PositiveCompacts
rejections.why_failed: Mathlib has no CompactSpace/PositiveCompacts instance for Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ
rejections.workaround: Measure.toSphere on Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ × ℂ) 1 — S³ = SU(2), avoiding the compactness wall

rejections.name: specialUnitaryGroup-as-group
rejections.wall: treating specialUnitaryGroup as a Group (the group tactic)
rejections.why_failed: specialUnitaryGroup is a Submonoid, not a Group; the inverse lives in the Subgroup

rejections.name: prod-insert-subset-identity
rejections.why_failed: metavariable / wrong occurrence — rw couldn't target ∏ p ∈ insert a x
rejections.workaround: show B = C + apply sum_congr rfl + intro + explicit pointwise prod_insert

rejections.name: neighborset-subtype-walk-count
rejections.wall: G.neighborSet as a type in the walks-count bound
rejections.why_failed: G.neighborSet : V → Set V is not a type; the sum over it needs the subtype
rejections.workaround: explicit {w : V // w ∈ G.neighborSet u} + Fintype.card_coe (Finset.filter (Adj u) univ)
